title: Focused authority and installation review of CI-UI Operations, Decisions and Reports
purpose: Close the three existing E2E parent entries that the acceptance map previously knew only as gate metadata; classify the concrete installation/auth helper chain without re-auditing every commercial leaf.

supersedes.scope: The three CI-UI spec entries now have body and authority-helper evidence. No prior document edited, no LIVE or PASS assertion added.

method.access: GitHub MCP fixed-pin fetches; content reviewed in V8. No shell, checkout, product/test execution, sf-ci, Actions or public message.
method.review: Each row declares full-body or exact focal ranges. The three spec bodies and named installation/authentication helpers were read. Commercial computations outside stated ranges were not re-audited.
method.graph: actualEdges are observed imports/calls/owned child prerequisites; nonImportEdges explicitly name manifest, subprocess and handle invocation relations. ParentTests are exact scoped parents, not a claim of exhaustive repository-wide reverse closure.
method.proofClassification: Original local operator sessions are real local sessions, not Microsoft. Planned CI-UI uses controlled signed OIDC/JWKS/Graph with original auth/factory/domain handlers. G08/G10 require actual Microsoft/tenant/host contexts and remain separate.
method.mutability: 26 existing rows classified; 23 helper/runner rows never count as independent test files. Two new E2E supports are proposed plus extension of an already proposed central Teams fixture; no new standalone test file is introduced here.
method.metadata: The counts are files and top-level declarations read, not observed collected/passed cases. Baseline and final results are NOT_RUN.

CURRENT_PIN.meaning: Real local identity handler, session storage, host graph and product ports, with macos synthetic principals/local enrollment. Does not establish Microsoft, Teams, guest semantics or real tenant membership.

PLANNED_CI_UI.meaning: Real Microsoft authentication validation and application/factory/SQLite/native producers, signed synthetic token/JWKS/PKCE/nonce and bounded controlled Graph/OIDC transport; correct HTTPS/Secure cookie contract. Not LIVE Entra/Teams or final artifact attestation.

G08.meaning: Actual original authenticated host contexts, real memberships/consent/revocation, exact assembled Linux artifact. No controlled provider, injected cookie, storageState or fake business reply as qualification.

G10.meaning: Actual host-admitted backup/effect/restore and genuine receipts. CI-UI fixtures cannot stand in for this proof.
